jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Spare Key
jokes.joke: I found out my ex moved on when I went to return her spare key and there was already a locksmith changing the locks. That hurt. Not because she didn’t trust me—because he looked at the key, looked at me, and said, “Don’t worry, this one hasn’t worked here in a long time.”

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Locked Out of Love
jokes.joke: My ex started dating a locksmith. Which feels like a personal insult from the universe, because now there is a man out there who is professionally, physically incapable of being locked out of anything, and I can't even get back into my own relationship. I still have a key to her apartment. I tried it last week out of curiosity. He'd already changed the locks. Of course he did. It's free for him.

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Her Type
jokes.joke: I just found out my ex moved on and is dating a guy who runs an antiques store. Honestly, it gave me a lot of closure. It’s comforting to know she still has the exact same type: dusty, overly fragile, and completely useless in a modern household.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Locked Out
jokes.joke: You guys, my love interest moved on last week and I was a mess. Stood outside my apartment sobbing, couldn't even get my key in the door. So I call a locksmith at midnight. Guy shows up, checks it out, and goes, "Lock's fine, pal... but that heart of yours is jammed shut." Handed him sixty bucks and said keep the change. Cheapest therapy I've ever had.

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Locked Out of Love
jokes.joke: My ex moved on so fast I had to call a locksmith just to keep up emotionally. The guy shows up, sees me on the floor eating cereal from the box, and goes, “Buddy, this isn’t a lock problem.” I said, “It is if she still has a key.” He changed the locks, handed me the bill, and whispered, “Heal.”
